parse.title: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
parse.text: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling (also known as UFC Fight Night 294) is an upcoming mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that is scheduled to take place on November 21, 2026, at the Ali Bin Hamad al-Attiyah Arena in Al Rayyan, Qatar.[1]
